toegepas.voor: in die son, en word hulle meer werd
toegepas.na: in die son, en hulle word meer werd
toegepas.rede_vinder: After the coordinating 'en' a new main clause normally takes subject-verb order; 'en word hulle' reads stiff.
toegepas.fout: Once the comma marks a new main clause, the inverted 'en word hulle' reads stiff.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Subject-verb order after the comma is the natural Afrikaans form, with the same actors, action and order.

toegepas.blok: Wat dit langs die pad kos
toegepas.voor: Die dae van gis en droog
toegepas.na: Die dae wat die bone gis en droog
toegepas.rede_vinder: Bare verbs used as nouns after 'van' are awkward; a short clause is natural and stays within the list allowance.
toegepas.fout: Bare verbs used as nouns after 'van' ('van gis en droog') read awkwardly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A short clause is clearer for a Grade 6 reader and adds nothing the lesson does not already say.

laat_vaar.voor: na die hawe en per skip weg
laat_vaar.na: na die hawe en van daar per skip weg
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Makes clear that the ship leaves from the harbour, so the two transport legs read in sequence rather than as alternatives.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original already reads as two legs in order, so 'van daar' only makes the sentence longer.
